name: Vault MCP Server (mschuchard)
description: A third-party MCP server for interacting with HashiCorp Vault to manage ACL policies, audit devices, and secret engines like KV v2, PKI, and Transit. It provides tools for system backend administration and includes prompts for generating security policy configurations.
